# 丹方鑑源--獨孤滔

**ID:** KR5c0325
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0315

## Authors / Editors
- 獨孤滔

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Mirror of the Sources of Elixir Recipes*

by [獨孤滔](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8D%A8%E5%AD%A4%E6%BB%94) (Dúgū Tāo) — mid-Táng Daoist alchemist

A mid-Táng **alchemical-pharmacological lexicon** cataloguing the sources and synonyms of ingredients used in *dān fāng* 丹方 (elixir recipes). A companion-work to Méi Biāo's [KR5c0299](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0299) *Shí yào ěr yǎ* (806) in the line of Táng alchemical reference works. Dated 836. Preserved as **DZ 925** / CT 925 (*Dòngshén bù, Zhòng shù lèi* 洞神部眾術類).

**Dating.** 836. Dynasty: 唐.
